name: io.github.mattoddie/proxmox-mcp
title: Proxmox VE
description: Monitor and manage Proxmox VE clusters: VMs, containers, storage and backups. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Runs the server over stdio. The image defaults to HTTP.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of any node in the cluster, with the port.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Recommended. The whole API token as user@realm!tokenid=secret. Leave empty to use a username and password.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Used instead of an API token, as user@realm (e.g. mcp@pve).

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: The user's password, used with the username.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_TLS_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: Recommended for Proxmox's self-signed certificate: its SHA-256 fingerprint. An https URL needs this or PROXMOX_VERIFY_SSL.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Leave empty when you set a fingerprint. true: the certificate is publicly trusted. false: skip the check (insecure).

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_DEFAULT_NODE
environmentVariables.description: Node used when a request doesn't name one. Not needed on a single-node install.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Allow changes: start and stop guests, edit configuration, create VMs, snapshots and backups.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_ALLOW_DELETES
environmentVariables.description: Also allow deleting guests, volumes, snapshots, backups and configuration. Needs writes.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_ALLOW_EXEC
environmentVariables.description: Also allow commands and file access inside VMs through the guest agent. Needs writes.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated toolsets, to expose fewer tools. Empty means all (except raw).

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Optional. stderr, or a file path inside the container, to log every change as a JSON line.
